results.note: Several red and green autumn leaves overlap against a trunk and twigs; the front-left leaf shows its lobes and teeth. Crowded frame so alone is false; autumn colour so not the usual look.
A leafy branch tip of green mature leaves that overlap each other in shade. Outlines can be traced only with close study, so shape and margin are search and the frame is crowded.
Autumn leaves in yellow, orange and red on a visible twig with opposite stalks; the central leaves read well but many leaves crowd the frame.
Whole trunk seen from a distance in a landscape, with moss on the lower part. Ridges are visible but small in the frame, so texture and pattern are search.
Dense yellow autumn leaves, sun-lit and partly backlit, filling the left of the frame with a red tree behind. Individual outlines and edges can be found only with study.
A whole small tree or shrub with red, orange and green leaves that blend into a mass beside water. No single leaf is the subject.
One sharp green mature leaf on a red stalk against a soft background, showing three lobes, teeth and veins. The stalk joins the twig out of frame.
A grey trunk with lichen patches and fairly smooth ridging in an autumn forest with a busy background. The surface is small in the frame, so texture is search.
A forked trunk with three stems, shot with bright sky behind the crown. Furrows are visible but small and soft, so texture and pattern need study.
Close view of dark grey ridged and plated bark with lichen. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge or scale object.
A red fallen leaf lies among brown litter and a mushroom. The outline reads but the edge is small, and litter competes for attention.
Deeply ridged and flaking bark on a trunk with fingers touching it at the left. The trunk edge shows at the right. The small file is sharp.
Close view of grey plated and ridged bark, a little soft at the corners from a wide lens. Texture only, with no trunk edge or scale object.
A full-width trunk with narrow vertical ridges and plates, with green foliage on both edges. The bark is sharp and the pattern repeats across the frame.
An orange and red autumn leaf with clear lobes and teeth, over conifer needles. Fine needles cross the frame but the leaf is the main subject.
The camera looks up the trunk into the crown, with sun flare and a birdhouse nailed to the bark. The bark texture is hard to read.
Backlit autumn leaves in orange and red overlap on a branch. The top-left leaf shows lobes, but most outlines need close study.
One large leaf, red and green, fills the frame with clear lobes, teeth and veins. Other leaves touch its edges but do not compete.
A trunk close up with shallow ridges and flaking pale and brown patches, with a twig across it and the trunk edge near the sides. The surface is sharp.
A scene of fallen red and brown leaves covering the ground. No single leaf is the subject.
Small pale-green and pink samara pairs hang among leaves and branches. The fruit is small in the frame and crowded, so kind and wing need a search. The wings look not yet fully developed.
Close view of green and pink samara pairs hanging from stalks. The fruit is still green and pink and not ripe. The light is shaded and dark behind.
Red samara clusters hang from a twig against plain blue sky. Wings and hang read clearly.
Dense red samara clusters hang from a twig in sun with a soft background. Wings are readable though overlapping.
Slim reddish-green samaras hang on thin stalks with a soft background. The shape is readable.
Close frame of rough, furrowed bark with broken plates and no trunk edge or scale object. The frame shows texture only.
Hanging samara clusters on red stalks with soft green background. Wings and hang are clear.
Whole trunk base on a lawn with vertical ridges and furrows visible. The trunk edges show, so the frame is not too close.
Single hanging leaf on a dark background, apparently the underside. The dark scene dims the colour and edge, so margin needs a search.
Twig tips with flowers and buds against a blurred background. The main subject is none of leaf, bark or fruit.
One whole green leaf on a plain black background, sharp. Lobes and margin read clearly.
One whole leaf lies on bark mulch, apparently the underside. The busy mulch competes with the leaf, but the outline is traceable.
Orange samara clusters on bare branches, lit by flash against a dark night scene. Many overlapping fruits are small in the frame, so shape and wing need a search.
Samara clusters hang from a twig with a soft green background. Wings and hang are clear.
Close frame of grey-brown scaly, ridged bark with no trunk edge, branch or scale object. The frame shows texture only.
Crown filling the frame with orange autumn leaves that blend into a mass. No single leaf outline or margin can be read.
Several green leaves with brown spots overlap on a twig, and the frame edge cuts one off. Each outline needs close study, and the background is busy.
Distant red samara clusters across the crown, seen from below against pine and sky. The fruit is small and crowded, so each feature needs a search.
Flower clusters hanging on bare twigs with a soft sky background. Flowers only, so the part is other.
Fallen yellow and red autumn leaves lie in a pile. The central leaf shows its outline, but the overlapping leaves compete with it.

Green mature maple leaf seen from below, outline and lobes readable against soft leafy background; another leaf overlaps at right but the main leaf stands out. Underside view and slight tilt make it harder (angle).
Whole trunk with trunk edges and background; deep vertical ridges and plates are readable and colour is natural.
Trunk in front of a brick building, ridged and plated bark clear, trunk edges visible.
One whole green leaf, upper side, on a plain white background with soft shadows; outline, lobe tips and margin all readable.
Camera looks up the trunk into the crown of a gnarled old tree; bark is foreshortened and competes with branches and foliage.
Trunk with vertical flaking ridges and plates, trunk edges visible, brick building behind.
A small sapling in a garden bed among hostas and a fence; the main subject is a whole young plant, not a leaf, bark or fruit.
A whole small sapling in a yard with hedges and lawn; leaves blend into a mass and no leaf, bark or fruit is the subject.
Twig on a black background with a cluster of paired samaras, green seed bodies and tan wings, so not fully ripe; samaras overlap each other and leaves, so the outline of one takes some study.
Crown of a tree in orange autumn colour, leaves form a mass; no single leaf is the subject.
Old gnarled trunk in grass with moss patches; long peeling plates and ridges are readable and the trunk edges show.
Trunk with long vertical flaking ridges against brick and a lamp post; trunk edges visible.
Pale grey trunk with a branch, lichen and moss patches in a bare winter wood; ridges are shallow and low contrast, so the pattern needs study.
Texture-only close-up with no trunk edge; warm reddish light tints the bark and the plates repeat is not fully shown.
Wide view of a forked old trunk in autumn woods with dappled sun and shade; bark detail is small in the frame and patchy.
A single ripe paired samara with a 1 cm scale bar on a plain purple background; wings and seed bodies are sharp.
Close crop of rough ridged bark with moss and lichen; no trunk edge, so texture only and the repeat pattern is hard to read.
Close, sharp view of grey bark with long vertical ridges and flaking plates; no trunk edge or scale in frame.
Small image of a trunk covered in lichen patches; ridges are visible but lichen hides the bark colour and the pattern takes study.
Pile of fallen leaves in yellow, orange and red autumn colour; leaves overlap and crowd each other so a single outline takes close study.
A single sugar maple samara lying flat on snow, seen from above, with a sprouting root tip. The germinating state and the top view make it harder.
Wide trunk area with narrow ridged plates and both trunk edges in frame. Sharp and easy to read.
Hanging white oak leaves seen from below and against the sky, backlit and overlapping. One central leaf is whole, but the others crowd it, so lobes and margin need study.
Underside of a pale grey-green white oak leaf against a dark soft background. The leaf base and one lobe are cut by the frame edge, so whole is false.
Branch with many overlapping lobed leaves and a small acorn pair among them. The leaves compete and the lobes are small in the frame.
Sunlit branch full of deeply lobed leaves, crowded and overlapping with no single subject. A learner can trace a few lobes only with study.
Dry brown samara pairs hanging from a twig, lit by warm low sun with a soft background. Warm light shifts the colour.
Two ripe acorns on a plain blue background, one with its cap and one without, with a 1 cm scale bar. Sharp and easy to read.
Wet, lobed leaves on a drooping branch seen from above, over mulch. Several lobed outlines read, but the leaves overlap and the edge detail is small.
Green acorns of full shape in their warty caps, sitting on the twig among leaves. They are not ripe, so usual_look is false.
Trunk with rough ridges and plates and both edges in frame. Dappled shade with a bright streak changes the colour.
Trunk with blocky, scaly plates in a woodland, with both edges and a soft background. The plates read well.
Grey trunk with shallow scaly ridges and both edges in frame. Sharp in even light.
View up the trunk into a forked crown, so the main subject is the whole tree. The part is other and the view is from below.
Hanging cluster of green samaras with pale wings against a soft background. They have full shape but are not ripe.
Close view of a lobed leaf with several holes and yellow galls. The top of the leaf is cut by the frame, and the damage makes it harder.
A green acorn in its cap is partly hidden behind the edge of a large leaf in the foreground, seen from the side. The leaf competes and the acorn is not ripe.
Samara cluster with green seed bodies and tan wings on a branch, against a black background that looks flash-lit. The flash changes the colours.
Three large lobed leaves radiate from one twig node against dark foliage. Lobes, edge and veins read, and the stalks join the twig.
Tall trunk with vertical ridges and flat plates, both edges in frame. Clear and sharp in even shade.
A single green acorn with a warty cap hangs on a twig among leaves. Full shape but not ripe, so unripe and not the usual look.
Pile of dead brown leaf litter in harsh shadow, with overlapping leaves. The subject is dead leaves, so dead_leaf. Light is harsh and uneven.
A cluster of green acorns with warty caps on a twig, leaves around. Acorns are full shape but unripe.
One whole green leaf seen from below with pointed lobes and bristle tips and visible veins. A few small spots do not change the outline.
Wide view of a large trunk with long ridges and furrows, trunk edges and base showing. Small lichen patches only.
Young translucent spring leaves with a few catkins on a twig, sunlit against a soft background. Young leaves not at full shape, and the bright light shifts the colour.
Camera looks up a trunk into the crown, bark foreshortened and dark. Pattern is hard to read, so the up-view reject applies.
Several green pointed-lobed leaves crowd a branch, with some leaves cut by the frame. Margin needs close study among the crowd.
Three green acorns with warty caps hang from a twig under lobed leaves. Full shape but unripe.
Three green leaves joined at one point are held against a mossy trunk. Outline is readable; tips and edge need a closer look. The stalks do not show a twig join.
Overlapping green leaves on a branch with a trunk and forest floor behind. The leaves crowd each other, so the edge takes a search.
Backlit yellow-green spring leaves with hanging catkins on a twig. Young leaves and backlight shift colour and outline; the leaves are still the subject.
A crown of red autumn leaves blending into a mass with branches. No single leaf can be read, so the part is other.
Sunlit leaves turning yellow and orange on a shoot, against dark foliage. The strong light and colour change the look; autumn colour is not a cause.
Red autumn leaves on a branch, soft focus, with a conifer behind. Edges can be traced only with close study; small leaves in the frame.
Green lobed leaves seen from above on a shoot, with other leaves crowding. Central leaf outline is readable; edge needs a search.
A cluster of ripe brown-pink acorns with warty caps on a twig. The slide-like tint and dark shade shift the colour.
Sunlit green leaves on a branch crowd each other, with a trunk behind. Margin needs close study among the crowd.
A whole tree in red autumn colour in a forest scene. The main subject is a crown, so the part is other.
Camera looks up a tall trunk into the crown. Ridges are readable near the base, but the view is from below.
A crown seen from below with yellowing and green leaves blended into a mass; no single leaf outline or margin can be traced. Autumn colour and an upward angle.
Close, sharp view of deep vertical ridges and furrows filling the frame. No trunk edge or scale object, so it is texture only.
A crown view with many overlapping leaves and a few small orange flowers; leaves form a mass and no single outline or margin reads clearly. Viewed from below.
A whole trunk on a street with a street scene behind it. Shallow ridges are partly covered by lichen patches, so the ridge pattern needs some study.
A single ripe acorn with a shallow scaly cap, hanging from its twig stalk against a soft green background.
Four acorns on a black background, including one with a cap, a cap from above and nuts from the end. Sharp, plain background, no sign of hanging.
Several overlapping green leaves with lobes visible, but crowded with leaves behind them. A learner has to pick one leaf out to read the outline and edge.
Low, lobed leaves seen from above among weeds and small plants, looking like young or seedling foliage. The outline differs from the mature leaf and the background competes.
Overlapping leaves on a twig seen from below with a green bud among them; leaves are crowded and cut by the frame, so outline and edge need study.
Close view of plates and furrows with yellow lichen. Warm low sun changes the colour. No trunk edge or scale object.
A wide trunk area with both edges visible, showing grey vertical ridges and furrows in even light.
New spring leaves and a folded bud on one twig against blue sky, with the stalks joining the twig. The leaves are young and not fully expanded.
An acorn with its cap plus nuts from the side and the end on a blue background with a 1 cm scale bar. Some views are from the end.
One whole green leaf on a dark plain background, with lobes, entire margin and veins clear. A few small spots do not change the outline.
Branches of the crown against the sky in warm low sun. The leaves are small and blend into a mass, and no outline or margin can be read.
Flowers on a twig with leaves around them. The main subject is the flowers, so the part is other.
Green unripe acorns with caps on a twig among leaves, hanging on the twig. Leaves and twigs compete with the fruit.
One whole green leaf with lobes, entire edge and veins clear, over a background of fallen yellow leaves that shows the autumn season.
Yellow-orange flowers on a branch with leaves around. The main subject is the flowers, so the part is other.
Five ripe acorns laid on a plain light background, sharp and well lit, with caps and nuts clear.
A crown seen from below with many small fruit and a few autumn leaves in a tangle of twigs. No single leaf, fruit or bark area is the subject, so the part is other.
Close-up of deep, interlacing diamond ridges with some lichen. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge, branch or scale object, so too_close is true.
A whole trunk with both edges in view and plain ridges and pale furrows that are easy to read. The background is soft and does not compete.
A big dark trunk base seen from a distance in a busy forest. The ridges can be traced only with study, so the key features are search. Deep forest shade darkens the colour.
Frosted dry cones of samaras on bare twigs against a plain blue background. Kind and shape are readable and the fruit sits on the twig. The individual wings are small, so wing is search.
Several trunks in a bare winter wood, one in dark shade and one covered in vine. The pale ridge pattern is small in the frame and competes with other trunks. Cast shadows cut across the bark.
Two small, dry, opened fruit on a twig against blurred autumn foliage. They are small in the frame, so kind, shape and wing take close study. The fruit has mostly shed its samaras.
One dry fruit held upright on a twig against soft blue sky. The cone outline is easy to read. The samara wings are fine and need a closer look.

A top view of the splayed, opened fruit on snow, with the central spike showing. The top view hides the cone outline, so it is angle. The spread-out form is not the typical closed cone, so it is atypical.
Close-up of vertical ridges and furrows covered in yellow lichen. Only texture is in the frame, so too_close is true. The lichen hides the true bark colour, so colour is search.
The camera looks straight up a trunk into a leafy crown. The bark is foreshortened, and the crown and branches compete for attention.
A dry upright cone of samaras on a plain black background, easy to read. The stalk is cut short, so the hang cannot be seen. The flash on black changes the colour a little.
Two children stand in front of a very large trunk. The people are the main subject of the scene. Bark is only a backdrop, so the part is other.
A full trunk width with both edges visible, showing pale furrows between rough ridges. The ridge pattern and colour are easy to read.
A sunlit trunk with both edges visible against sky, showing sharp vertical ridges with pale furrows. The leaves at the edges are small and do not compete.
A whole trunk against sky and foliage with clear ridges and light furrows. The trunk edges are in the frame and the view is straight on.
A weathered, fallen fruit lying in leaf litter and dry grass. Debris and clover compete with it. It is old and not in its typical form.
A sharp dry cone of samaras on its twig against a soft green and yellow background. A leaf at the left edge is out of focus and does not compete.
A sharp dry cone of samaras on a bare twig tip against a soft green background. The kind, shape and wings are easy to read.
A green, closed fruit of full shape on its twig among soft leaves. It is not ripe, so the usual look is false. The samara wings are not yet separate.
Backlit underside of a large leaf in front of other leaves, with the tip touching the bottom frame edge. The crowding and the backlight make the outline and edge harder to read.
Several overlapping green leaves on a twig against a busy autumn background. The two upper leaves show their outline, but the teeth are small and the leaves crowd each other.
A stack of overlapping leaves in green, red and brown autumn colour, seen from below against the sky. Lower leaves are cut by the frame edge and the leaves crowd each other.
The camera looks up a trunk and its branches against the sky, with many twigs in front. The view up into the crown makes the bark pattern hard to read.
One whole green leaf in front of a plain dark and grass background, with the toothed edge and lobe tips easy to read. The twig is visible at the top but the stalk join is small.
One large whole green leaf on a grass background, with a second leaf cut by the left frame edge. The outline and teeth are easy to read.
Two pale-green leaves, undersides up, held in a hand against mottled trunk bark and leaf litter. The busy background competes and the edge teeth are small.

A leaf lit by flash against a black night background, with brown lesions and spots on it and on the leaf above. The flash changes the colour, and the damage is on the leaf but its outline is still readable.
One dry cone of winged samaras sitting upright on the twig tip, against snow. The kind, outline, wings and the way it sits on the twig are all easy to see.
Close view of mottled flaking bark with green-grey, cream and red-brown patches, filling the frame. There is no trunk edge, branch or scale object in the frame.
A trunk base beside a road, with parked cars and a kerb competing in the frame. The trunk is dark and small in the frame, so the bark pattern needs close study.
Bare crown branches against a blue sky, with a few small dry fruit cones that are too tiny to read. The main subject is the crown, so the part is other.
A whole green leaf at the centre with other leaves overlapping it, and a small bud and stalk at the top. The leaf is readable, but the crowd of leaves competes.
A leafy sapling or shrub whose leaves blend into one green mass, with trees behind it. No single leaf outline or edge can be read.
A bare tree trunk and crown seen from below, with many branches against the sky. The main subject is the whole tree, so the part is other.
A forked old trunk with a hollow, in leafy forest undergrowth. The main subject is the whole tree in a scene, so the part is other.
A leafy shoot laid flat on a pale wooden deck, with several leaf outlines, toothed edges and the stalks joining the twig all visible. The plain background keeps the leaves easy to see.
A trunk with peeling cream and brown plates, with a branch crossing in front and another at the top. The branches compete with the bark but the pattern is readable.
A speckled underside of one leaf among other leaves, with dark spots on its surface. The edge is only partly visible and the surrounding leaves crowd it.
One whole pale-green leaf with a mottled surface, held against gravel ground, with leaves cut by the frame at the top. The lobes and teeth are easy to read.

A green seed ball hangs from a stalk in front of a large leaf, with shadow on the left. It is full shape but green, so unripe. The twig is not in frame, so hang takes a search. Shadow falls on the ball.
A large lobed leaf held beside a hand. The right lobe is cut by the frame edge and other leaves crowd the background. A gall, a hole and a brown patch change the outline a little.
A leafless tree seen from below against blue sky. The main subject is the whole tree and crown, so the part is other.
Many small seed balls scattered over bare branches against blue sky. Each ball is tiny in the frame, so kind, shape and hang need a search. Viewed from below.
Brown seed balls hang on long stalks from one twig against plain blue sky. Kind, shape and hang read easily.
Close view of mottled, flaking bark in grey, green and cream with a knob. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge, branch or scale object, so too_close.
A seed ball that has lost its fluff lies on a log, showing its pitted surface, with a second broken ball behind it. It is not the typical hanging ball, and it is seen from above on a busy background.
A trunk base beside a curb and a parked car, seen from a distance. The bark pattern is small in the frame and the curb and car compete, so the key features need a search.
A small young seed ball hangs from a twig with a new leaf unfolding, so it is spring. The ball is small and still forming, so its outline needs a search.
A trunk with pale mottled bark and a scar, with leaves and branches crossing the frame. The pattern shows, the fine texture needs a search, and the leaves compete. Dappled light.
A tree-lined walkway with a canopy of leaves. The main subject is a scene of many trees, so the part is other.
A large yellow-green seed ball hangs on a long stalk from a twig, with a blurred background of bare branches. It is full shape but not yet ripe brown. Hang shows clearly.
A green seed ball on a stalk against soft autumn-coloured leaves. The ball is full shape but green, so unripe. The twig is hidden in leaves, so hang needs a search.
A whole tree with white upper limbs and dark lower trunk among leaves. The subject is the tree, so the part is other.
A seed ball breaking apart on a log, with a bare core and a ring of loose fluff. This is not the typical ball outline, and it is seen from above.
Many brown seed balls hang on stalks from bare twigs against plain blue sky. The balls are small but round and easy to read. Seen from below.
A seed ball that is releasing its fluff hangs on a stalk against a soft background. The shed fluff makes it not the typical form. The twig is out of frame, so hang takes a search.
A small green seed ball hangs on a thin stalk from a bare twig with buds, with a soft grey background. The ball is green, not ripe brown. Dull overcast light.
A trunk with flaking, peeling bark in brown, tan and cream, with the trunk edge visible. Texture and pattern read clearly.
A large brown seed ball with bristly points fills the frame against sky and bare branches. Kind and shape are clear. Only the top of the stalk shows, so hang takes a search. Seen from slightly below.
Canopy seen from below with many overlapping green leaves and one seed ball at lower right; the leaves crowd and are backlit, so outline and edge need close study. Angle and light make it harder.
Trunk with pale, brown and grey peeling plates filling the frame; both trunk edges show. Surface and flaking pattern read well.
Bright, partly overexposed leaves crowd the twig beside a trunk with wires behind; the leaves overlap, so outline and edge need study. Strong light washes out the colour.
Tall trunk section with cream, olive and brown flaking plates against a soft background. Pattern is wide enough to repeat and trunk edges show.
Rough, deeply flaking bark filling the frame with no trunk edge; half of it is in deep shadow, which dims colour and hides the plate pattern.
Narrow but sharp trunk with cream, olive and brown plates; a building behind is plain and does not compete. Trunk edges show.
Close-up of mottled green, yellow and brown patches, texture only with no trunk edge. Pattern is vivid and sharp.
A dry brown fallen leaf on grass among other dead leaves. The subject is a dead leaf, so it is rejected.
Camera looks up a forked, knobbly trunk into a bare crown against sky; the bark is dark and no plate pattern repeat can be read.
Smooth trunk with large cream, grey and olive patches against green foliage. Trunk edges show and the camouflage pattern is clear.
Tight view of a few peeling plates in warm low sun with a hard shadow. The area is too small for the pattern to repeat and the warm light shifts the colour.
Large green leaf in front of a pale trunk, held by a partly shown hand at the top. The frame edges cut off the lobe tips on both sides.
A street lined with trees and cyclists; a scene, not a leaf, bark or fruit.
Several seed balls hang singly on stalks against blue sky, seen from below among leaves. They are small and green-brown, so not yet ripe, and no stalk shows two balls.
One whole green leaf held in a hand, with soft foliage behind. Lobes, edge and veins read well and the hand gives scale.
A dense mass of overlapping leaves and twigs filling the frame; no single leaf outline stands out.
One whole green leaf against a dark soft background, with its stalk and other leaves at the edges. Lobes and toothed edge are clear.
Green leaves on a twig in front of a shaded, blurred trunk; the photo has an old film look and dark shade. The main leaf outline and edge read well.
Pale trunk with a fine crazed plate pattern, palm leaves soft behind. Both trunk edges show.
Trunk heavily covered with grey-green lichen that hides much of the plate pattern and colour; it takes study to read.
A brown spiky seed ball held in a hand against soft leaf litter. Kind and shape are clear; the hand hides how it hangs, and only one ball shows.
Two ripe seed balls hang one below the other on a twig against blue sky with a soft background. Both are fully in frame, and the stalk and hang are clear.

A small green unripe seed ball hangs from a stalk held in a hand, with leaves and the hand competing for attention. The ball is small in the frame so its shape needs a search, and the hand hides the hang.
A seed ball breaking apart on paving, with fluffy seeds scattered nearby. It is a broken, atypical form seen from above, so kind and shape need close study.
A single green unripe seed ball hangs on a long stalk among planetree leaves. The ball is the main subject and the hang is clear, but only one ball shows.
A single green unripe seed ball dangles from a long stalk against a soft green background. Kind, shape and hang are clear; there is no second ball.
Two pale green seed balls hang on one stalk beneath a large leaf, with a third ball partly hidden behind. Leaves behind them compete somewhat, so alone is false.
A dense mass of planetree foliage with only one or two leaves partly readable and a few tiny fruits barely visible. The leaves blend into a crown, so this is a leaf_mass reject.
A scene of a trunk with brown autumn leaves in warm low sun and a small green ball far from the camera. No single part is the main subject, so the part is other.
A single dark brown seed ball seen from below against bright sky gaps, shown mostly as a silhouette among large leaves. The upward angle and backlight hide surface detail, so kind needs a search.
Several dark ripe seed balls on bare twigs, photographed from below against blue sky, so they are partly in silhouette. Each ball hangs on its own stalk, so two balls on one stalk do not show.

Red and orange autumn leaves crowd a branch, and the leaves blend into one mass, so no single outline can be traced. The lobes and margin need close study, and the leaf stalks do not show where they join the twig.
A dense green crown of overlapping mature leaves fills the frame and blends into a mass. Some lobes can be seen, but a learner must search to trace one leaf outline.
A branch of autumn leaves in yellow, orange and red, with a front leaf whose lobes read clearly. The autumn colour is not a cause, and the margin needs a close look.
The whole moss-covered tree stands on a grassy slope, with bare branches above. The main subject is the tree, not a leaf, bark area or fruit, so the part is other.
Yellow autumn foliage fills the foreground against strong backlight, and the leaves overlap into a mass. The backlight washes the colour, and the outlines need a search to trace.
Several red, yellow and green autumn leaves hang on a branch with purple asters behind. The main leaf is cut off at the bottom, and its lobes and margin need a close look.
One whole, full-size green leaf is shown against a plain dark background. The three lobes, the serrated margin and the veins are all clear.
A grey trunk with lichen patches stands in a woodland with autumn leaves behind it. The ridges can be seen only from a distance, so the texture and pattern need a search.
A forked trunk with grey-brown ridged plates shows the bark pattern clearly. A hollow cavity sits in the fork, which is damage, but the bark texture is still readable.
A close view of grey ridged bark with lichen shows the ridges and plates clearly. No trunk edge or branch is in the frame, so it is a texture-only photo.
A fallen red maple leaf lies among dead brown leaves and a mushroom on the forest floor. The subject is a dead, fallen leaf, so it is rejected.
Deeply ridged grey-brown bark fills the frame, and a hand points at it with the trunk edge visible at the right. The hand is not a fault, and the ridges and plates read clearly.
A close view of grey-brown bark shows the ridges, plates and lichen clearly. No trunk edge, branch or scale object is in the frame, so it is a texture-only photo.
A tall grey trunk fills the frame against blurred green woodland. From this distance the ridges need a search to read.
One red and green autumn leaf with three clear lobes is shown against evergreen foliage. The margin is small in the frame and needs a search, and the autumn colour is not a cause.
A birdhouse on a tree trunk with a strong sun flare, taken looking up into the canopy. The main subject is a scene with a birdhouse, so the part is other, and the backlight is a cause.
A tangled cluster of orange autumn leaves is backlit and soft, and the leaves blend into one mass. The backlight changes the colour, and the outlines are readable only with a search.
One large red and green autumn leaf fills the frame, with its lobes, teeth and veins clear. The base and one tip are cut off by the frame edge, so the leaf is not whole.
Reddish-grey bark with pale patches and plates fills the frame, and a short twig stub is at the top left. The ridges and plates read clearly.
A pile of fallen brown, red and pink leaves covers the ground, so the subject is dead leaves that blend into a mass. The outlines of a few leaves are visible only with a search.
Pale green-pink samaras in a crown shot with leaves and buildings behind, so the wings and outline are small and need a search. Fresh spring growth, so the samaras are not yet ripe.
Close view of a samara cluster with clear wings and a plain soft background. The photo does not show how the fruit hangs from the twig. Pink-green colour, so not yet ripe.
Red samaras hang in clear clusters from bare grey twigs against blue sky, so the wings and hang are readable. Bare branches and red colour point to spring, with the fruit not yet brown and ripe.
Pink-red samaras hang in clusters from a twig with the wings fully visible against a soft background. Spring colour with the fruit still red, not ripe.
Samaras hang on a thin twig with green leaves beside them, and the wings overlap each other so their outline needs a search. Fresh pink-green fruit in spring, not yet ripe.
